issue.title: An agent's installed file name has two answers
issue.body:
Found by a stranger-AI test of the catalog, 2026-11-10.

For `@cat-agent-skills/acroform_writer`:
- its agent page (`a/@cat-agent-skills/acroform_writer/agent.md`, load step 2) saves it as `acroform_writer_agent.py`
- `registry.json` gives `_install_filename`: `rar_cat_agent_skills_acroform_writer_agent.py`

Asked "what is its file name once installed?", 1 of 2 strangers answered each. Both are reading the site correctly.

Why it matters: two install routes leave two differently named copies of one agent in the same agents folder, and the agent page's short name can collide across publishers (two publishers, same slug).

Not checked: which name the installer (`add.sh`) actually writes, and whether this holds for every agent or only some. One agent was read.

Suggested: pick one name, make the agent page and the registry say the same, and add a check that they match.
